title: Why Half The Ocean Is Changing Color
hook: Satellites caught the ocean quietly changing color, and scientists aren't sure what it means.
closing: Nobody knows yet what it means for the sea life down there, or for us.
question: Have you noticed the ocean looking different?

segments.say: Twenty years of NASA satellite data show 56 percent of the ocean's surface now looks different.
A 2019 climate model predicted about half the ocean would shift color -- satellites found a bit more than that.
The changed area covers roughly 203 million square kilometers, bigger than every continent on Earth combined.
